en_title: Rockstar Games Releases 39 New GTA 6 Screenshots to Celebrate Two Weeks from Launch
cn_title: Rockstar发布39张《GTA6》新截图，庆祝距离游戏发售还有两周
opus_summary: Rockstar发布了39张《GTA6》新截图，展示了Vice City、当地居民、脱衣舞俱乐部及Jason和Lucia将参与的犯罪活动。游戏将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series，11月10日开放预载，需占用212 GB存储空间。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games has released a few dozen new screenshots from GTA 6 to celebrate the game being two weeks away from launch.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar发布了数十张《GTA6》的新截图，庆祝距离游戏发售还有两周。

paragraphs.en: After 13 years of waiting, GTA 6 is finally almost here. The game is exactly 14 days away from release in the United States, and fans are eager to be able to visit Vice City once again. To help make the wait a bit more bearable, Rockstar has dropped 39 new screenshots from the game, which give us new looks at Vice City, the people within it, strip clubs, and some of the rip-roaring crimes that Jason and Lucia will take part in.
paragraphs.cn: 经过13年的等待，《GTA6》终于即将到来。距离游戏在美国发售正好还有14天，粉丝们迫不及待地想要再次造访Vice City。为了让等待稍微好熬一些，Rockstar发布了39张游戏新截图，让我们得以一睹Vice City、城中的居民、脱衣舞俱乐部，以及Jason和Lucia将参与的一些刺激犯罪活动。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games released what is expected to be the final trailer for GTA 6 last month , which has been airing on TV constantly since its debut online. The game's marketing is also hard to ignore, as cities around the world have been covered in billboards, posters, and bus decals. Rockstar has gone all-out in the city of Miami by taking over the Miami Heat arena with GTA branding , selling in-universe beers from the games at bars, and flying a Vice City blimp around the city. Rockstar has essentially turned Miami into Vice City in real life , flexing the game's cultural power.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar上个月发布了预计将是《GTA6》最后一支预告片的视频，自从在网上首播以来，这支预告片一直在电视上反复播放。游戏的营销活动也令人难以忽视，世界各地的城市都布满了广告牌、海报和公交车贴。Rockstar在迈阿密市全力以赴，用《GTA》品牌标识占据了迈阿密热火队的球馆，在酒吧销售游戏世界中的啤酒，还让一艘Vice City飞艇在城市上空飞行。Rockstar实际上已将迈阿密变成了现实生活中的Vice City，展现了游戏的文化影响力。

paragraphs.en: On November 18, Rockstar will also host a special event it calls "A Night in Vice City," which will feature a special NBA game between the Miami Heat and the Milwaukee Bucks. The Heat will be turned into the Vice City Heat and sport GTA-themed jerseys, while also playing on a new court. It's unclear if there will be other events in the city, but it wouldn't be surprising. Miami's nightclubs have also been turned into the GTA clubs over the last couple of weeks, showing a total takeover from Rockstar.
paragraphs.cn: 11月18日，Rockstar还将举办一场名为「A Night in Vice City」的特别活动，其中将有一场迈阿密热火队对阵密尔沃基雄鹿队的NBA特别比赛。热火队将变身为Vice City Heat，身穿《GTA》主题球衣，并在新的球场上比赛。目前尚不清楚城中是否还会有其他活动，但如果有也并不令人意外。过去几周里，迈阿密的夜总会也被改造成了《GTA》中的俱乐部，展现出Rockstar对这座城市的全面占领。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Pre-loading will begin on November 10 and will take up 212 GBs of space on your storage device. The game has already racked up an estimated $750 million in pre-orders , suggesting it will break an absurd amount of records once the floodgates open on release weekend.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。预载将于11月10日开始，游戏将占用存储设备212 GB的空间。据估计，游戏的预购额已达7.5亿美元，这表明一旦发售周末到来，游戏将打破数量惊人的纪录。
